pdf.howToRead:
How to find a point on site:
1. ID on the plan → row in the table.
2. Room and wall number (the number by the black
   triangle in the corner).
3. Measure the distance along the wall from the
   corner with the triangle — the LEFT corner when
   you face the wall from inside the room.
4. Height = centre of the point above finished floor.
At the symbol (if there is room): distance · h height [cm].
